guynmart_wizard_12.m: It is dangerous here. Please stay outside, in front of the signs on the floor, and wait there. I will be with you in a minute.

guynmart_wizard_21.m: Welcome, $playername. I am Rorthron, the world's most famous ringmaker. I know Andor, your brother. He sometimes consulted me about newly found rings.
r: I have never met a ringmaker.
Andor! Do you know where he was bound?

guynmart_wizard_22.m: A lot. If ever you find one of the strong, old rings, come and show it to me. I might enhance it for you, as I already did for Andor. Don't forget to bring some bonemeal potions as a sign of friendship.

guynmart_wizard_24.m: Maybe you want to look at my fine collection of rings? Unfortunately I have no ring of real power available just now. But I sell them for a good price.

guynmart_wizard_28.m: No, sorry. I tend not to ask about things that are personal.
r: That's a pity. I have been trailing my big brother for quite some time.
What do you know about magic rings?

guynmart_wizard_30.m: Ah - just one thing: I know the power some rings can have, and I would prefer you took yours off in my presence.

guynmart_wizard_40.m: Be welcome, $playername. I am Rorthron, the world's most famous ringmaker. I know Andor, your brother. He sometimes consulted me about newly found rings.
r: You know me? And my brother?
Andor! Do you know where he was bound?

guynmart_wizard_42.m: You and Andor are different. You will be legendary. Well do I know your deeds! And I even heard rumors that you gained the legends of legends, the mighty Ring of lesser Shadow!

guynmart_wizard_50.m:
With the help of some bonemeal potions I could improve it to be an even greater ring. The powers will be similar but greater. It will become the
** Ring of far lesser Shadow **
You are lucky indeed.

guynmart_wizard_54.m: Really. When my work is done, your ring will be stronger than ever.
r: Great! I didn't know that the ring lore has not been totally forgotten.
Hmm, I like my ring the way it is.
Do you have any rings in stock?

guynmart_wizard_58.m: Eleven bonemeal potions of course. I need these potions for, eh, my work.

guynmart_wizard_60.m: Now to work - put the ring into the golden vessel here.
r: Thank you for your offer Rorthron. Here is the ring - be careful with it.
No, I would never give you my ring.
Oops? What does "oops" mean? Something went wrong?

guynmart_wizard_72.m: Oh no, it is nothing. All is ... well, perfect. Yes. Now go, go and leave me, I have work to do. No need to thank me. Farewell.

guynmart_wizard_74.m: Forget the bonemeal potions. You owe me nothing. Farewell now.
